item.title: Supes hear Suisun Valley Road report
item.description: A new traffic study of Suisun Valley Road found that the corridor is generally operating well today, but weekend congestion and future winery and agritourism growth — particularly near Interstate 80 — could strain the southern segment in the years ahead. The Solano County Board of Supervisors on Tuesday discussed the results of a Traffic Capacity Analysis on Suisun Valley Road, an artery of the Suisun Valley area and a road that saw 69 collisions between 2018 and 2022. item.title: Vacaville Unified names new superintendent
item.description: The Vacaville Unified School District named Sasha Begell as its next Superintendent of Schools on Tuesday. Begell, who currently serves as Associate Superintendent of Educational Services will take on the role when current Superintendent Ed Santopadre retires at the end of the school year. The VUSD School Board is scheduled to vote its final approval of the promotion at its March 12 meeting. item.title: Supervisors increase waste rates in unincorporated area
item.description: The Solano County Board of Supervisors voted 4-0 to increase waste collection rates in the unincorporated area by three percent at Tuesday’s meeting. Supervisor John Vasquez was not present at the meeting. Services included in the increase include weekly collections of solid waste, organics and recyclables, drop off events for electronics, hazardous waste and mattresses, as well as bulky item pickups.
